scope: Static external-force validity and circular tidal-opening diagnostics for the fixed NGC 3201 host; no remnant or Galactic orbit integration

galaxy.R_status: catalog external-environment benchmark, not jointly sampled with host distance
galaxy.vc_status: literature benchmark, not a fitted Galactic rotation measurement

scenario_interpretation: Sensitivity cases, not confidence intervals or an orbit of NGC 3201. The 13 kpc case is only the circular surrogate discussed by Wan et al.
tidal_opening: solve G M(<rJ)/rJ^3 = 2 vc^2/R^2 for the unmodified spherical host; compare exact circular inward/outward saddles
validity_limit: first radius where vc^2 r^3/[G M(<r) R(R-r)] exceeds epsilon; instantaneous all-direction force bound in translating nonrotating axes
interpretation: Validity crossing censors an isolated control; neither validity nor Jacobi-radius crossing establishes irreversible escape. No central-rest rule or absorbing escape radius is selected.
deferred: joint host and Galactic phase-space uncertainty
real eccentric Galactic orbit and time-dependent tides
